description: Modify the Cloudflare integration to only provision the SESSION KV binding when the session feature is actually being used. Currently, the binding is always created even when sessions aren't needed, which causes unnecessary resource consumption and potential configuration issues.
functional_requirements: Add logic to detect whether session functionality is enabled in the application
Only include the SESSION KV binding in the Cloudflare Workers configuration when sessions are required
Ensure the integration gracefully handles both scenarios (with and without sessions) without breaking existing functionality
Update any related configuration generation or validation logic to reflect this conditional behavior
